```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  dpi = 96,
  fig.align = "center",
  out.width = "100%"
)
source(file.path("..", "..", "pkgdown", "validation-helpers.R"))
bundle <- load_validation_bundle()
counts <- bundle$manifest$counts
```

RSYC yield curves were validated against independent ground plots from
`r bundle$manifest$validation$reference`. Each curve was compared with the
plots located in its tile or ecological unit. Plots were grouped into
`r bundle$manifest$validation$age_class_width`-year age classes, and plots
older than 150 years were excluded. For each age class, the weighted mean of
the plot observations and its
`r scales::percent(bundle$manifest$validation$ci_level)` confidence interval
(CI) were compared with the mean RSYC prediction for the same plots.

These results describe model release **`r bundle$version`**:
`r format(counts$validated_models, big.mark = ",")` of
`r format(counts$models, big.mark = ",")` published curves had enough plots
to validate. The remaining curves could not be validated because too few
suitable plots were available in their area.

This page summarises the validation results and shows scatterplots for
each response, model scale, and spatial level. The
[Curve explorer](curve-explorer.html) maps the curves and their validation
statistics and shows the validation data for individual curves.

## Summary statistics {.tabset}

Statistics are calculated for each curve from its age-class means and then
summarised across curves. CCC is Lin's concordance correlation coefficient,
which measures agreement with the 1:1 line (1 = perfect agreement) and so,
unlike R², is reduced by bias. Bias is the mean difference between the RSYC
prediction and the observed plot mean, so positive values mean the curve
overestimates the plots.

```{r summary-table, results = "asis"}
summary_table <- validation_summary_table(bundle)
for (y_var in response_names) {
  for (scale in scale_labels) {
    cat("###", y_var, "–", scale, "\n\n")
    summary_table %>%
      filter(Response == y_var, Scale == scale) %>%
      select(-Response, -Scale) %>%
      knitr::kable(digits = c(0, 0, 0, 2, 2, 1, 1)) %>%
      print()
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

## Observed vs predicted

Each point is one age class of one curve: the weighted mean of the plot
observations (x axis) against the mean RSYC prediction for the same plots
(y axis). Panels show the generic model, the coniferous and broadleaf
models, and the species models. Species are ordered by number of points.
AGB points with plot means of 400 Mg/ha or more are excluded, and panels
with fewer than ten points are omitted.

```{r scatterplots, results = "asis"}
for (y_var in names(response_names)) {
  cat("###", response_names[[y_var]], "\n\n")
  for (scale in names(scale_labels)) {
    cat("####", scale_labels[[scale]], "models {.tabset}\n\n")
    for (level in spatial_levels) {
      points <- validation_points(bundle, y_var, scale, level)
      if (nrow(points) == 0) {
        next
      }
      n_panels <- n_distinct(points$species_name)
      cat("#####", spatial_labels[[level]], "\n\n")
      cat(
        sprintf(
          "%s age-class points from %s curves. [Map these curves](%s) in the curve explorer.\n\n",
          format(nrow(points), big.mark = ","),
          format(n_distinct(points$key), big.mark = ","),
          explorer_link(y_var, scale, level, metric = "ccc")
        )
      )
      knit_figure(
        validation_scatterplot(points, y_var),
        height = figure_height(n_panels, 1.87, 3.75),
        alt = sprintf(
          "Scatterplots of %s RSYC predictions against plot means for %s %s models, one panel per model.",
          response_names[[y_var]], scale, level
        )
      )
    }
  }
}
```
